text.p: OfficeMax Inc said Wednesday it agreed in principle to acquire 63 Staples/Office Depot superstores in key major metropolitan markets where OfficeMax currently does not have a presence or is operating a limited number of stores.

The company agreed to purchase the assets of 63 stores of Staples Inc and Office Depot Inc for $108.75 million in cash and anticipates the acquisition will be accretive to earnings, chief executive Michael Feuer said.

OfficeMax said new market entries among the purchases include Baltimore; Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Tampa/St. Petersburg and Louisville, Ky., together with 14 stores in the Los Angeles area where OfficeMax entered the market this last year with 19 TriMax Super Centers. The company also gained locations in 11 other markets.

The transaction is subject to approval by the Federal Trade Commission and conditioned on the sale of the stores to OfficeMax being the predicate for a consent settlement of the commission's investigation of the proposed merger between Staples and Office Depot, OfficeMax explained.
